title: Nsight Compute basic profile for N=16 packed NF4 two-row kernel
device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (compute capability 8.9)
scope_and_limits: Each number is from one Nsight Compute profiled launch; it is not a latency benchmark.

A separate local-memory counter run observed zero local-memory sectors for both launches; this is evidence of no runtime local-memory spill traffic in these exact compiled launches, not a guarantee for other shapes or compiler configurations.
Both projections are register-limited in theoretical occupancy; achieved occupancy is lower than theoretical.
The compute and DRAM utilization readings indicate both resources are material; this does not isolate a single bottleneck.
